verses.text: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the LORD our God giveth us.

verses.text: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as *appeareth* this day.
verses.strongsText: But[H8711] Sihon[H5511] king[H4428] of[H4480] Heshbon[H2809] would[H14] not[H3808] let us[H587] pass[H5674] by[H8713] him[H1931]: for[H3588] the[H8712] LORD[H3068] thy[H859] God[H430] hardened[H7185] his[H1931] spirit[H7307], and[H8711] made his[H1931] heart[H3824] obstinate[H553], that[H834] he[H1931] might deliver[H5414] him[H1931] into[H8714] thy[H859] hand[H3027], as[H834] appeareth this day[H3117].

verses.text: And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.

verses.text: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.

verses.text: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:

verses.text: From Aroer, which *is* by the brink of the river of Arnon, and *from* the city that *is* by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the LORD our God delivered all unto us:

verses.text: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

verses.text: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The LORD your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all *that are* meet for the war.

verses.text: Until the LORD have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and *until* they also possess the land which the LORD your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and *then* shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.

verses.text: And I besought the LORD at that time, saying,

verses.text: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he *was* the firstborn of Joseph; *to wit*, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

verses.text: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)
verses.strongsText: (For[H3588] six[H8337] months[H2320] did Joab[H3097] remain[H3427] there[H3426] with[H5973] all[H3605] Israel[H3478], until he[H1931] had[H1961] cut off[H3772] every[H3605] male[H2145] in[H8713] Edom[H123]:)

verses.text: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father's servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad *being* yet a little child.

verses.text: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.
verses.strongsText: And[H8711] they[H1992] arose[H6965] out[H3318] of[H4480] Midian[H4080], and[H8711] came[H935] to[H8714] Paran[H6290]: and[H8711] they[H1992] took[H3947] men[H582] with[H5973] them[H1992] out[H3318] of[H4480] Paran[H6290], and[H8711] they[H1992] came[H935] to[H8714] Egypt[H4714], unto[H8714] Pharaoh[H6547] king[H4428] of[H4480] Egypt[H4714]; which[H834] gave[H5414] him[H1931] an house[H1004], and[H8711] appointed[H559] him[H1931] victuals[H3899], and[H8711] gave[H5414] him[H1931] land[H776].

verses.strongsText: And[H8711] the[H8712] sister[H269] of[H4480] Tahpenes[H8472] bare[H3205] him[H1931] Genubath[H1592] his[H1931] son[H1121], whom Tahpenes[H8472] weaned[H1580] in[H8432] Pharaoh's[H6547] house[H1004]: and[H8711] Genubath[H1592] was[H1961] in[H8713] Pharaoh's[H6547] household[H1004] among[H8432] the[H8712] sons[H1121] of[H4480] Pharaoh[H6547].

verses.text: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.
verses.strongsText: And[H8711] when[H834] Hadad[H1908] heard[H8085] in[H8713] Egypt[H4714] that[H834] David[H1732] slept[H7901] with[H5973] his[H1931] fathers[H1], and[H8711] that[H834] Joab[H3097] the[H8712] captain[H8269] of[H4480] the[H8712] host[H6635] was[H1961] dead[H4191], Hadad[H1908] said[H559] to[H8714] Pharaoh[H6547], Let me[H589] depart[H7971], that[H834] I[H589] may go[H3212] to[H8714] mine[H589] own country[H776].

verses.text: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.
verses.strongsText: Then[H227] Pharaoh[H6547] said[H559] unto[H8714] him[H1931], But[H8711] what hast thou[H859] lacked[H2638] with[H5973] me[H589], that[H834], behold[H2009], thou[H859] seekest[H1245] to[H8714] go[H3212] to[H8714] thine[H859] own country[H776]? verses.text: And God stirred him up *another* adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:
verses.strongsText: And[H8711] God[H430] stirred him[H1931] up[H6965] another adversary[H7854], Rezon[H7331] the[H8712] son[H1121] of[H4480] Eliadah[H450], which[H834] fled[H1272] from[H4480] his[H1931] lord[H113] Hadadezer[H1909] king[H4428] of[H4480] Zobah[H6678]:

verses.strongsText: And[H8711] he[H1931] gathered[H6908] men[H582] unto[H8714] him[H1931], and[H8711] became captain[H8269] over a band[H1416], when[H834] David[H1732] slew[H2026] them[H1992] of[H4480] Zobah: and[H8711] they[H1992] went[H3212] to[H8714] Damascus[H1834], and[H8711] dwelt[H3427] therein, and[H8711] reigned[H4427] in[H8713] Damascus[H1834].

verses.text: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad *did*: and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.
verses.strongsText: And[H8711] he[H1931] was[H1961] an adversary[H7854] to[H8714] Israel[H3478] all[H3605] the[H8712] days[H3117] of[H4480] Solomon[H8010], beside the[H8712] mischief[H7451] that[H834] Hadad[H1908] did: and[H8711] he[H1931] abhorred[H6973] Israel[H3478], and[H8711] reigned[H4427] over Syria[H758].

verses.text: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon's servant, whose mother's name *was* Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up *his* hand against the king.
verses.strongsText: And[H8711] Jeroboam[H3379] the[H8712] son[H1121] of[H4480] Nebat[H5028], an Ephrathite[H673] of[H4480] Zereda[H6868], Solomon's[H8010] servant[H5650], whose mother's[H517] name[H8034] was[H1961] Zeruah[H6871], a widow[H490] woman[H802], even he[H1931] lifted up[H7311] his[H1931] hand[H3027] against the[H8712] king[H4428].

verses.text: And this *was* the cause that he lifted up *his* hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, *and* repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.
verses.strongsText: And[H8711] this was[H1961] the[H8712] cause[H1697] that[H834] he[H1931] lifted up[H7311] his[H1931] hand[H3027] against the[H8712] king[H4428]: Solomon[H8010] built[H1129] Millo[H4407], and[H8711] repaired[H5462] the[H8712] breaches[H6556] of[H4480] the[H8712] city[H5892] of[H4480] David[H1732] his[H1931] father[H1].

verses.text: And the man Jeroboam *was* a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.
verses.strongsText: And[H8711] the[H8712] man[H376] Jeroboam[H3379] was[H1961] a mighty man[H1368] of[H4480] valour[H2428]: and[H8711] Solomon[H8010] seeing[H7200] the[H8712] young man[H5288] that[H834] he[H1931] was[H1961] industrious[H6213] [H4399], he[H1931] made him[H1931] ruler[H6485] over all[H3605] the[H8712] charge[H5447] of[H4480] the[H8712] house[H1004] of[H4480] Joseph[H3130].

verses.text: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two *were* alone in the field:
verses.strongsText: And[H8711] it[H1931] came to[H8714] pass at that[H834] time[H6256] when[H834] Jeroboam[H3379] went out[H3318] of[H4480] Jerusalem[H3389], that[H834] the[H8712] prophet[H5030] Ahijah[H281] the[H8712] Shilonite[H7888] found[H4672] him[H1931] in[H8713] the[H8712] way[H1870]; and[H8711] he[H1931] had[H1961] clad[H3680] himself with[H5973] a new[H2319] garment[H8008]; and[H8711] they[H1992] two[H8147] were[H1961] alone in[H8713] the[H8712] field[H7704]:

verses.text: And Ahijah caught the new garment that *was* on him, and rent it *in* twelve pieces:
verses.strongsText: And[H8711] Ahijah[H281] caught[H8610] the[H8712] new[H2319] garment[H8008] that[H834] was[H1961] on him[H1931], and[H8711] rent[H7167] it[H1931] in[H8713] twelve[H8147] [H6240] pieces[H7168]:

verses.text: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces: for thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee:

verses.text: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)
verses.strongsText: (But[H8711] he[H1931] shall[H1961] have[H1961] one[H259] tribe[H7626] for[H3588] my[H589] servant[H5650] David's[H1732] sake, and[H8711] for[H3588] Jerusalem's[H3389] sake, the[H8712] city[H5892] which[H834] I[H589] have[H1961] chosen[H977] out[H3318] of[H4480] all[H3605] the[H8712] tribes[H7626] of[H4480] Israel[H3478]:)

verses.text: Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do *that which is* right in mine eyes, and *to keep* my statutes and my judgments, as *did* David his father.
verses.strongsText: Because that[H834] they[H1992] have[H1961] forsaken[H5800] me[H589], and[H8711] have[H1961] worshipped[H7812] Ashtoreth[H6253] the[H8712] goddess[H430] of[H4480] the[H8712] Zidonians[H6722], Chemosh[H3645] the[H8712] god[H430] of[H4480] the[H8712] Moabites[H4124], and[H8711] Milcom[H4445] the[H8712] god[H430] of[H4480] the[H8712] children[H1121] of[H4480] Ammon[H5983], and[H8711] have[H1961] not[H3808] walked[H1980] in[H8713] my[H589] ways[H1870], to[H8714] do[H6213] that[H834] which[H834] is[H1961] right[H3477] in[H8713] mine[H589] eyes[H5869], and[H8711] to[H8714] keep my[H589] statutes[H2708] and[H8711] my[H589] judgments[H4941], as[H834] did David[H1732] his[H1931] father[H1].

verses.text: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant's sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:
verses.strongsText: Howbeit I[H589] will not[H3808] take[H3947] the[H8712] whole kingdom[H4467] out[H3318] of[H4480] his[H1931] hand[H3027]: but[H8711] I[H589] will make[H7896] him[H1931] prince[H5387] all[H3605] the[H8712] days[H3117] of[H4480] his[H1931] life[H2416] for[H3588] David[H1732] my[H589] servant's[H5650] sake, whom I[H589] chose[H977], because he[H1931] kept[H8104] my[H589] commandments[H4687] and[H8711] my[H589] statutes[H2708]:

verses.text: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.

verses.text: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do *that is* right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.
verses.strongsText: And[H8711] it[H1931] shall[H1961] be[H1961], if thou[H859] wilt hearken[H8085] unto[H8714] all[H3605] that[H834] I[H589] command[H6680] thee[H859], and[H8711] wilt walk[H1980] in[H8713] my[H589] ways[H1870], and[H8711] do[H6213] that[H834] is[H1961] right[H3477] in[H8713] my[H589] sight[H5869], to[H8714] keep[H8104] my[H589] statutes[H2708] and[H8711] my[H589] commandments[H4687], as[H834] David[H1732] my[H589] servant[H5650] did[H6213]; that[H834] I[H589] will be[H1961] with[H5973] thee[H859], and[H8711] build[H1129] thee[H859] a sure[H539] house[H1004], as[H834] I[H589] built[H1129] for[H3588] David[H1732], and[H8711] will give[H5414] Israel[H3478] unto[H8714] thee[H859].

verses.text: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.
verses.strongsText: And[H8711] I[H589] will for[H3588] this afflict[H6031] the[H8712] seed[H2233] of[H4480] David[H1732], but[H8711] not[H3808] for[H3588] ever[H3117].

verses.text: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, *are* they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

verses.text: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

verses.text: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard *of it*, (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)
verses.strongsText: And[H8711] it[H1931] came to[H8714] pass, when[H834] Jeroboam[H3379] the[H8712] son[H1121] of[H4480] Nebat[H5028], who[H4310] was[H1961] yet in[H8713] Egypt[H4714], heard[H8085] of[H4480] it[H1931], (for[H3588] he[H1931] was[H1961] fled[H1272] from[H4480] the[H8712] presence[H6440] of[H4480] king[H4428] Solomon[H8010], and[H8711] Jeroboam[H3379] dwelt[H3427] in[H8713] Egypt[H4714];)

verses.text: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,
verses.strongsText: That[H834] they[H1992] sent[H7971] and[H8711] called[H7121] him[H1931]. And[H8711] Jeroboam[H3379] and[H8711] all[H3605] the[H8712] congregation[H6951] of[H4480] Israel[H3478] came[H935], and[H8711] spake[H1696] unto[H8714] Rehoboam[H7346], saying[H559],

verses.strongsText: Thy[H859] father[H1] made[H7185] our[H587] yoke[H5923] grievous[H7185]: now[H6258] therefore make thou[H859] the[H8712] grievous[H7186] service[H5656] of[H4480] thy[H859] father[H1], and[H8711] his[H1931] heavy[H3515] yoke[H5923] which[H834] he[H1931] put[H5414] upon[H5921] us[H587], lighter[H7043], and[H8711] we[H587] will serve[H5647] thee[H859].

verses.text: And he said unto them, Depart yet *for* three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.

verses.text: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do ye advise that I may answer this people?

verses.text: And they brought *it*. And he saith unto them, Whose *is* this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.

verses.text: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] Jesus[G2424] answering[G611] said[G2036] unto[G1519] them[G846], Render[G591] to[G1519] Caesar[G2541] the[G3588] things that[G3754] are[G3588] Caesar's[G2541], and[G2532] to[G1519] God[G2316] the[G3588] things that[G3754] are[G3588] God's[G2316]. And[G2532] they[G846] marvelled[G2296] at[G1909] him[G846].

verses.text: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,

verses.text: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] Jesus[G2424] answering[G611] said[G2036] unto[G1519] them[G846], Do ye[G4105] not[G3756] therefore[G1223] [G5124] err[G4105], because ye[G5210] know[G1492] not[G3361] the[G3588] scriptures[G1124], neither[G3366] the[G3588] power[G1411] of[G1537] God[G2316]?

verses.text: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I *am* the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] as[G5613] touching[G4012] the[G3588] dead[G3498], that[G3754] they[G846] rise[G1453]: have[G2192] ye[G314] not[G3756] read[G314] in[G1722] the[G3588] book[G976] of[G1537] Moses[G3475], how[G5613] in[G1909] the[G3588] bush[G942] God[G2316] spake[G2036] unto[G1519] him[G846], saying[G3004], I[G1473] am[G1510] the[G3588] God[G2316] of[G1537] Abraham[G11], and[G2532] the[G3588] God[G2316] of[G1537] Isaac[G2464], and[G2532] the[G3588] God[G2316] of[G1537] Jacob[G2384]?

verses.text: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?

verses.text: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:

verses.text: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
verses.strongsText: What[G5101] man[G444] of[G1537] you[G5216], having[G2192] an hundred[G1540] sheep[G4263], if[G2532] he[G846] lose[G622] one[G1520] of[G1537] them[G846], doth[G2641] not[G3756] leave[G2641] the[G3588] ninety and[G2532] nine[G1768] in[G1722] the[G3588] wilderness[G2048], and[G2532] go[G4198] after[G1909] that[G3754] which[G3739] is[G2076] lost[G622], until[G2193] he[G846] find[G2147] it[G846]?

verses.text: And when he hath found *it*, he layeth *it* on his shoulders, rejoicing.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] when[G3753] he[G846] hath found[G2147] it[G846], he[G846] layeth[G2007] it[G846] on[G1909] his[G1438] shoulders[G5606], rejoicing[G5463].

verses.text: And when he cometh home, he calleth together *his* friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] when[G3753] he[G846] cometh[G2064] [G1519] home[G3624], he[G846] calleth together[G4779] his[G846] friends[G5384] and[G2532] neighbours[G1069], saying[G3004] unto[G1519] them[G846], Rejoice[G4796] with[G3326] me[G3427]; for[G3754] I[G1473] have[G2192] found[G2147] my[G3450] sheep[G4263] which[G3588] was[G2258] lost[G622].

verses.text: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
verses.strongsText: I[G1473] say[G3004] unto[G1519] you[G5213], that[G3754] likewise[G3779] joy[G5479] shall[G1510] be[G2071] in[G1722] heaven[G3772] over[G1909] one[G1520] sinner[G268] that[G3754] repenteth[G3340], more than[G2228] over[G1909] ninety and[G2532] nine[G1768] just persons[G1342], which[G3748] need[G2192] [G5532] no[G3756] repentance[G3341].

verses.text: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find *it*?
verses.strongsText: Either[G2228] what[G5101] woman[G1135] having[G2192] ten[G1176] pieces of[G1537] silver[G1406], if[G1437] she[G846] lose[G622] one[G3391] piece[G1406], doth not[G3780] light[G681] a candle[G3088], and[G2532] sweep[G4563] the[G3588] house[G3614], and[G2532] seek[G2212] diligently[G1960] till[G2193] [G3755] she[G846] find[G2147] it[G846]?

verses.strongsText: And[G2532] when[G3753] she[G846] hath found[G2147] it[G846], she[G846] calleth[G4779] her friends[G5384] and[G2532] her neighbours[G1069] together[G4779], saying[G3004], Rejoice[G4796] with[G3326] me[G3427]; for[G3754] I[G1473] have[G2192] found[G2147] the[G3588] piece[G1406] which[G3739] I[G1473] had[G2192] lost[G622].

verses.text: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.

verses.text: And he said, A certain man had two sons:

verses.strongsText: And[G2532] the[G3588] younger[G3501] of[G1537] them[G846] said[G2036] to[G1519] his[G846] father[G3962], Father[G3962], give[G1325] me[G3427] the[G3588] portion[G3313] of[G1537] goods[G3776] that[G3754] falleth[G1911] to[G1519] me[G1691]. And[G2532] he[G846] divided[G1244] unto[G1519] them[G846] his[G846] living[G979].

verses.text: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] not[G3756] many[G4183] days[G2250] after[G3326] the[G3588] younger[G3501] son[G5207] gathered[G4863] all[G537] together[G4863], and[G2532] took his[G846] journey[G589] into[G1519] a far[G3117] country[G5561], and[G2532] there[G1563] wasted[G1287] his[G846] substance[G3776] with[G3326] riotous[G811] living[G2198].

verses.text: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] when[G3753] he[G846] had[G2192] spent[G1159] all[G3956], there[G1563] arose[G1096] a mighty[G2478] famine[G3042] in[G2596] that[G1565] land[G5561]; and[G2532] he[G846] began[G756] to[G1519] be[G1510] in[G1722] want[G5302].

verses.text: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] he[G846] went[G4198] and[G2532] joined himself[G2853] to[G1520] a citizen[G4177] of[G1537] that[G1565] country[G5561]; and[G2532] he[G846] sent[G3992] him[G846] into[G1519] his[G846] fields[G68] to[G1519] feed[G1006] swine[G5519].

verses.text: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] he[G846] would fain[G1937] have[G2192] filled[G1072] his[G846] belly[G2836] with[G575] the[G3588] husks[G2769] that[G3739] the[G3588] swine[G5519] did eat[G2068]: and[G2532] no man[G3762] gave[G1325] unto[G1519] him[G846].

verses.text: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] when[G3753] he[G846] came[G2064] to[G1519] himself[G1438], he[G846] said[G2036], How many[G4214] hired servants[G3407] of[G1537] my[G3450] father's[G3962] have[G2192] bread[G740] enough and[G2532] to[G1519] spare[G4052], and[G1161] I[G1473] perish[G622] with[G3326] hunger[G3042]!

verses.text: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,

verses.strongsText: And[G2532] he[G846] arose[G450], and[G2532] came[G2064] to[G4314] his[G1438] father[G3962]. But[G1161] when[G3753] he[G846] was[G2258] yet[G2089] a great way[G3112] off[G568], his[G846] father[G3962] saw[G1492] him[G846], and[G2532] had[G2192] compassion[G4697], and[G2532] ran[G5143], and[G2532] fell[G1968] on[G1909] his[G846] neck[G5137], and[G2532] kissed[G2705] him[G846].

verses.text: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put *it* on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on *his* feet:

verses.text: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill *it*; and let us eat, and be merry:
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] bring hither[G5342] the[G3588] fatted[G4618] calf[G3448], and[G2532] kill[G2380] it[G846]; and[G2532] let us[G2248] eat[G5315], and[G2532] be[G1510] merry[G2165]:

verses.text: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.

verses.text: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.

verses.text: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.

verses.text: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.

verses.text: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.

verses.text: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

Ye[G5210] cannot[G3756] [G1410] serve[G1398] God[G2316] and[G2532] mammon[G3126].

verses.text: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.

verses.strongsText: Jesus[G2424] answered[G611], My[G1699] kingdom[G932] is[G2076] not[G3756] of[G1537] this[G5127] world[G2889]: if[G1487] my[G1699] kingdom[G932] were[G2258] of[G1537] this[G5127] world[G2889], then[G5119] would[G302] my[G1699] servants[G5257] fight[G75], that[G3363] I[G1473] should[G3860] not[G3363] be[G1510] delivered[G3860] to[G1519] the[G3588] Jews[G2453]: but[G1161] now[G3568] is[G2076] my[G1699] kingdom[G932] not[G3756] from[G575] hence[G1782].

verses.text: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
verses.strongsText: Pilate[G4091] therefore[G3767] said[G2036] unto[G1519] him[G846], Art[G1488] thou[G4771] a king[G935] then[G3766]? To[G1519] this[G5124] end was[G1080] I[G1473] born[G1080], and[G2532] for[G1519] this[G5124] cause came I[G2064] into[G1519] the[G3588] world[G2889], that[G2443] I[G1473] should bear witness[G3140] unto[G1519] the[G3588] truth[G225]. Every[G3956] one[G3956] that[G3754] is[G5607] of[G1537] the[G3588] truth[G225] heareth[G191] my[G3450] voice[G5456].

verses.text: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault *at all*.

And[G2532] when[G3753] he[G846] had[G2192] said[G2036] this[G5124], he[G846] went out[G1831] again[G3825] unto[G4314] the[G3588] Jews[G2453], and[G2532] saith[G3004] unto[G1519] them[G846], I[G1473] find[G2147] in[G1722] him[G846] no[G3762] fault[G156] at all[G3956].

verses.text: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

verses.strongsText: When[G3753] the[G3588] chief priests[G749] therefore[G3767] and[G2532] officers[G5257] saw[G1492] him[G846], they[G846] cried out[G2905], saying[G3004], Crucify[G4717] him[G846], crucify[G4717] him[G846]. verses.text: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;

verses.text: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.

verses.text: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, *Ye* men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.

verses.text: And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth.

verses.text: Then said Paul unto him, God shall smite thee, *thou* whited wall: for sittest thou to judge me after the law, and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law?
verses.strongsText: Then[G5119] said[G2036] Paul[G3972] unto[G4314] him[G846], God[G2316] shall[G3195] smite[G5180] thee[G4571], thou[G4771] whited[G2867] wall[G5109]: for[G2532] sittest[G2521] thou[G4771] to[G1519] judge[G2919] me[G3165] after[G2596] the[G3588] law[G3551], and[G2532] commandest[G2753] me[G3165] to[G1519] be[G1510] smitten[G5180] contrary to[G1519] the[G3588] law[G3891]?

verses.text: And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God's high priest?
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] they[G846] that[G3754] stood by[G3936] said[G2036], Revilest thou[G3058] God's[G2316] high priest[G749]?

verses.text: Then said Paul, I wist not, brethren, that he was the high priest: for it is written, Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people.

verses.text: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees, and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, Men *and* brethren, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee: of the hope and resurrection of the dead I am called in question.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] when[G3753] Paul[G3972] perceived[G1097] that[G3754] the[G3588] one[G1520] part[G3313] were[G2076] Sadducees[G4523], and[G1161] the[G3588] other[G2087] Pharisees[G5330], he[G846] cried out[G2896] in[G1722] the[G3588] council[G4892], Men[G435] and[G2532] brethren[G80], I[G1473] am[G1510] a Pharisee[G5330], the[G3588] son[G5207] of[G1537] a Pharisee[G5330]: of[G4012] the[G3588] hope[G1680] and[G2532] resurrection[G386] of[G1537] the[G3588] dead[G3498] I[G1473] am[G1510] called in[G1722] question[G2919].

verses.text: And when he had so said, there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees: and the multitude was divided.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] when[G3753] he[G846] had[G2980] so[G5124] said[G2980], there[G1563] arose[G1096] a dissension[G4714] between the[G3588] Pharisees[G5330] and[G2532] the[G3588] Sadducees[G4523]: and[G2532] the[G3588] multitude[G4128] was[G2258] divided[G4977].

verses.text: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, neither angel, nor spirit: but the Pharisees confess both.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] [G3303] the[G3588] Sadducees[G4523] say[G3004] that[G3754] there[G1563] is[G1511] no[G3361] resurrection[G386], neither[G3366] angel[G32], nor[G3383] spirit[G4151]: but[G1161] the[G3588] Pharisees[G5330] confess[G3670] both[G297].

verses.text: And there arose a great cry: and the scribes *that were* of the Pharisees' part arose, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him, let us not fight against God.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] there[G1563] arose[G1096] a great[G3173] cry[G2906]: and[G2532] the[G3588] scribes[G1122] that[G3754] were[G2258] of[G1537] the[G3588] Pharisees'[G5330] part[G3313] arose[G450], and[G2532] strove[G1264], saying[G3004], We[G2249] find[G2147] no[G3762] evil[G2556] in[G1722] this[G5129] man[G444]: but[G1161] if[G1487] a spirit[G4151] or[G2228] an angel[G32] hath spoken[G2980] to[G1519] him[G846], let us[G2313] not[G3361] fight[G2313] against God.

verses.text: And when there arose a great dissension, the chief captain, fearing lest Paul should have been pulled in pieces of them, commanded the soldiers to go down, and to take him by force from among them, and to bring *him* into the castle.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] when[G3753] there[G1563] arose[G1096] a great[G4183] dissension[G4714], the[G3588] chief captain[G5506], fearing[G2125] lest[G3361] Paul[G3972] should have[G2192] been[G1096] pulled in[G1722] pieces[G1288] of[G5259] them[G846], commanded[G2753] the[G3588] soldiers[G4753] to[G1519] go down[G2597], and[G2532] to[G1519] take[G726] him[G846] by[G1223] force[G726] from[G1537] among[G3319] them[G846], and[G5037] to[G1519] bring[G71] him[G846] into[G1519] the[G3588] castle[G3925].

verses.text: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.

verses.text: And when it was day, certain of the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.

verses.strongsText: And[G1161] they[G846] were[G2258] more than[G4119] forty[G5062] which[G3588] had[G2192] made[G4160] this[G5026] conspiracy[G4945].

verses.text: And they came to the chief priests and elders, and said, We have bound ourselves under a great curse, that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul.

verses.text: Now therefore ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you to morrow, as though ye would enquire something more perfectly concerning him: and we, or ever he come near, are ready to kill him.

verses.text: And when Paul's sister's son heard of their lying in wait, he went and entered into the castle, and told Paul.

Farewell[G4517].

verses.strongsText: For[G1063] we[G2249] have[G2192] found[G2147] this[G5126] man[G435] a pestilent[G3061] fellow, and[G2532] a mover[G2795] of[G1537] sedition[G4714] among all[G3956] the[G3588] Jews[G2453] throughout[G2596] the[G3588] world[G3625], and[G5037] a ringleader[G4414] of[G1537] the[G3588] sect[G139] of[G1537] the[G3588] Nazarenes[G3480]:

verses.text: Who also hath gone about to profane the temple: whom we took, and would have judged according to our law.
verses.strongsText: Who[G3739] also[G2532] hath gone about[G3985] to[G1519] profane[G953] the[G3588] temple[G2411]:[G2532] whom[G3739] we[G2249] took[G2902], and[G2532] would[G2309] have[G2192] judged[G2919] according[G2596] to[G1519] our[G2251] law[G3551].

verses.text: But the chief captain Lysias came *upon us*, and with great violence took *him* away out of our hands,
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] the[G3588] chief captain[G5506] Lysias[G3079] came[G3928] upon[G1909] us[G2248], and[G2532] with[G3326] great[G4183] violence[G970] took him[G846] away[G520] out[G1831] of[G1537] our[G2257] hands[G5495],

verses.text: Commanding his accusers to come unto thee: by examining of whom thyself mayest take knowledge of all these things, whereof we accuse him.
verses.strongsText: Commanding[G2753] his[G846] accusers[G2725] to[G1519] come[G2064] unto[G1909] thee[G4571]: by[G1223] examining[G350] of[G3844] whom[G3739] thyself[G846] mayest[G1410] take knowledge[G1921] of[G4012] all[G3956] these things[G5130], whereof[G3739] we[G2249] accuse[G2723] him[G846].

verses.text: And the Jews also assented, saying that these things were so.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] the[G3588] Jews[G2453] also[G2532] assented[G4934], saying[G5335] that[G3754] these things[G5023] were[G2192] so[G3779].

verses.text: Then Paul, after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak, answered, Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation, I do the more cheerfully answer for myself:
verses.strongsText: Then[G1161] Paul[G3972], after[G3326] that[G3754] the[G3588] governor[G2232] had[G2192] beckoned[G3506] unto[G1519] him[G846] to[G1519] speak[G3004], answered[G611], Forasmuch as[G5613] I[G1473] know[G1987] that[G3754] thou[G4571] hast been[G5607] of[G1537] many[G4183] years[G2094] a judge[G2923] unto[G1519] this[G5129] nation[G1484], I[G1473] do[G626] the[G3588] more cheerfully[G2115] answer[G626] for[G4012] myself[G1683]:

verses.text: Because that thou mayest understand, that there are yet but twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem for to worship.
verses.strongsText: Because that[G3754] thou[G4675] mayest[G1410] understand[G1097], that[G3754] there[G1563] are[G1526] yet but[G2228] [G3756] twelve[G1177] days[G2250] [G4119] since[G575] [G3739] I[G3427] went up[G305] to[G1722] Jerusalem[G2419] for[G1063] to[G1519] worship[G4352].

verses.text: And they neither found me in the temple disputing with any man, neither raising up the people, neither in the synagogues, nor in the city:
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] they[G846] neither[G3777] found[G2147] me[G3165] in[G1722] the[G3588] temple[G2411] disputing[G1256] with[G4314] any man[G5100], neither[G2228] raising up[G1999] [G4160] the[G3588] people[G3793] [G1999], neither[G3777] in[G1722] the[G3588] synagogues[G4864], nor[G3777] in[G2596] the[G3588] city[G4172]:

verses.text: Neither can they prove the things whereof they now accuse me.
verses.strongsText: Neither[G3777] can[G1410] they[G846] prove[G3936] [G3165] the[G3588] things[G4012] whereof[G3739] they[G2723] now[G3568] accuse[G2723] me[G3450].

verses.text: But this I confess unto thee, that after the way which they call heresy, so worship I the God of my fathers, believing all things which are written in the law and in the prophets:
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] this[G5124] I[G1473] confess[G3670] unto[G1519] thee[G4671], that[G3754] after[G2596] the[G3588] way[G3598] which[G3739] they[G846] call[G3004] heresy[G139], so[G3779] worship I[G3000] the[G3588] God[G2316] of[G1537] my[G3450] fathers[G3971], believing[G4100] all[G3956] things[G3956] which[G3588] are[G1526] written[G1125] in[G2596] the[G3588] law[G3551] and[G2532] in[G1722] the[G3588] prophets[G4396]:

verses.text: And have hope toward God, which they themselves also allow, that there shall be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] have[G2192] hope[G1680] toward[G1519] God[G2316], which[G3739] they[G3778] themselves[G846] also[G2532] allow[G4327], that[G3754] there[G1563] shall[G1510] be[G3195] [G1510] a resurrection[G386] of[G1537] the[G3588] dead[G3498], both[G5037] of[G1537] the[G3588] just[G1342] and[G2532] unjust[G94].

verses.text: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and *toward* men.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] herein[G1722] [G5129] do I[G1473] exercise[G778] myself[G846], to[G1519] have[G2192] always[G1275] a conscience[G4893] void of[G1537] offence[G677] toward[G4314] God[G2316], and[G2532] toward men[G444].

verses.text: Now after many years I came to bring alms to my nation, and offerings.
verses.strongsText: Now[G1161] after[G1223] many[G4119] years[G2094] I[G1473] came[G3854] to[G1519] bring[G4160] alms[G1654] to[G1519] my[G3450] nation[G1484], and[G2532] offerings[G4376].

verses.text: Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, neither with multitude, nor with tumult.
verses.strongsText: [G1161] Whereupon[G1722] [G3739] certain[G5100] Jews[G2453] from[G575] Asia[G773] found[G2147] me[G3165] purified[G48] in[G1722] the[G3588] temple[G2411], neither[G3756] with[G3326] multitude[G3793], nor[G3761] with[G3326] tumult[G2351].

verses.text: Who ought to have been here before thee, and object, if they had ought against me.
verses.strongsText: Who[G3739] ought[G1163] [G1163] to[G1519] have[G2192] been[G1096] here[G3918] before[G1909] thee[G4675], and[G2532] object[G2723], if[G1536] they[G846] had[G2192] ought[G1536] against[G4314] me[G3165].

verses.text: Or else let these same *here* say, if they have found any evil doing in me, while I stood before the council,
verses.strongsText: Or[G2228] else[G2228] let[G2036] these[G846] same[G3778] here say[G2036], if[G1536] they[G846] have[G2192] found[G2147] any[G1536] evil doing[G92] in[G1722] me[G1698], while[G2193] I[G3450] stood[G2476] before[G1909] the[G3588] council[G4892],

verses.text: Except it be for this one voice, that I cried standing among them, Touching the resurrection of the dead I am called in question by you this day.
verses.strongsText: Except[G2228] it[G846] be[G1510] for[G4012] this[G5026] one[G3391] voice[G5456], that[G3739] I[G1473] cried[G2896] standing[G2476] among[G1722] them[G846], Touching[G3754] [G4012] the[G3588] resurrection[G386] of[G1537] the[G3588] dead[G3498] I[G1473] am[G1510] called in[G1722] question[G2919] by[G5259] you[G5216] this day[G4594].

verses.text: And when Felix heard these things, having more perfect knowledge of *that* way, he deferred them, and said, When Lysias the chief captain shall come down, I will know the uttermost of your matter.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] when[G3753] Felix[G5344] heard[G191] these things[G5023], having more perfect[G197] knowledge[G1492] of[G4012] that[G3754] way[G3598], he[G846] deferred[G306] them[G846], and[G2532] said[G2036], When[G3752] Lysias[G3079] the[G3588] chief captain[G5506] shall[G1510] come down[G2597], I[G1473] will know the[G3588] uttermost[G1231] of[G1537] your[G5209] matter[G2596].

verses.text: And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul, and to let *him* have liberty, and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him.
verses.strongsText: And[G5037] he[G846] commanded[G1299] a centurion[G1543] to[G1519] keep[G5083] Paul[G3972], and[G5037] to[G1519] let him[G846] have[G2192] liberty[G425], and[G2532] that[G3754] he[G846] should forbid[G2967] none[G3367] of[G1537] his[G846] acquaintance[G2398] to[G1519] minister[G5256] or[G2228] come[G4334] unto[G1519] him[G846].

verses.text: And after certain days, when Felix came with his wife Drusilla, which was a Jewess, he sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] after[G3326] certain[G5100] days[G2250], when[G3753] Felix[G5344] came[G3854] with[G4862] his[G846] wife[G1135] Drusilla[G1409], which[G3739] was[G5607] a Jewess[G2453], he[G846] sent for[G3343] Paul[G3972], and[G2532] heard[G191] him[G846] concerning[G4012] the[G3588] faith[G4102] in[G1519] Christ[G5547].

verses.text: And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come, Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] as[G5613] he[G846] reasoned[G1256] of[G4012] righteousness[G1343], temperance[G2532] [G1466], and[G2532] judgment[G2917] to[G1519] come[G3195] [G1510], Felix[G5344] trembled[G1096] [G1719], and[G2532] answered[G611], Go thy[G4675] way[G4198] for[G1063] this time[G3568]; when[G1161] I[G1473] have[G2192] [G3335] a convenient season[G2540], I[G1473] will call for[G3333] thee[G4571].

verses.text: He hoped also that money should have been given him of Paul, that he might loose him: wherefore he sent for him the oftener, and communed with him.
verses.strongsText: He[G846] hoped[G1679] also[G260] [G1161] [G2532] that[G3754] money[G5536] should have[G2192] been[G1096] given[G1325] him[G846] of[G5259] Paul[G3972], that[G3704] he[G846] might loose[G3089] him[G846]: wherefore[G1352] he[G846] sent for[G3343] him[G846] the[G3588] oftener[G4437], and[G2532] communed with[G3656] him[G846].

verses.text: But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix' room: and Felix, willing to shew the Jews a pleasure, left Paul bound.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] after[G4137] two years[G1333] Porcius[G4201] Festus[G5347] came[G2983] into[G1519] Felix'[G5344] room[G1240]: and[G5037] Felix[G5344], willing[G2309] to[G1519] shew[G2698] the[G3588] Jews[G2453] a pleasure[G5485], left[G2641] Paul[G3972] bound[G1210].

verses.text: Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem.
verses.strongsText: Now[G3767] when[G3753] Festus[G5347] was[G2258] come[G1910] into[G1519] the[G3588] province[G1885], after[G3326] three[G5140] days[G2250] he[G846] ascended[G305] from[G575] Caesarea[G2542] to[G1519] Jerusalem[G2414].

verses.text: Then the high priest and the chief of the Jews informed him against Paul, and besought him,
verses.strongsText: Then[G1161] the[G3588] high priest[G749] and[G2532] the[G3588] chief[G4413] of[G1537] the[G3588] Jews[G2453] informed[G1718] him[G846] against[G2596] Paul[G3972], and[G2532] besought[G3870] him[G846],

verses.text: And desired favour against him, that he would send for him to Jerusalem, laying wait in the way to kill him.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] desired[G154] favour[G5485] against[G2596] him[G846], that[G3704] he[G846] would send for[G3343] him[G846] to[G1519] Jerusalem[G2419], laying[G4160] wait[G1747] in[G2596] the[G3588] way[G3598] to[G1519] kill[G337] him[G846].

verses.text: But Festus answered, that Paul should be kept at Caesarea, and that he himself would depart shortly *thither*.
verses.strongsText: But[G3303] [G3767] Festus[G5347] answered[G611], that[G3754] Paul[G3972] should be[G1510] kept[G5083] at[G1722] Caesarea[G2542], and[G1161] that[G3754] he[G846] himself[G1438] would[G3195] depart[G1607] [G1722] shortly[G5034] thither.

verses.text: Let them therefore, said he, which among you are able, go down with *me*, and accuse this man, if there be any wickedness in him.
verses.strongsText: Let them[G846] therefore[G3767], said[G5346] he[G846], which[G3739] among[G1722] you[G5213] are[G1526] able[G1415], go down[G2597] with[G4782] me[G1691], and[G2532] accuse[G2723] this[G846] man[G435], if[G1536] there[G1563] be[G2076] any wickedness[G1536] in[G1722] him[G5129].

verses.text: And when he had tarried among them more than ten days, he went down unto Caesarea; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] when[G3753] he[G846] had[G2192] tarried[G1304] among[G1722] them[G846] more[G4119] than[G2228] ten[G1176] days[G2250], he[G846] went down[G2597] unto[G1519] Caesarea[G2542]; and[G2532] the[G3588] next day[G1887] sitting[G2523] on[G1909] the[G3588] judgment seat[G968] commanded[G2753] Paul[G3972] to[G1519] be[G1510] brought[G71].

verses.text: And when he was come, the Jews which came down from Jerusalem stood round about, and laid many and grievous complaints against Paul, which they could not prove.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] when[G3753] he[G846] was[G2258] come[G3854], the[G3588] Jews[G2453] which[G3739] came down[G2597] from[G575] Jerusalem[G2414] stood round about[G4026], and[G2532] laid[G5342] many[G4183] and[G2532] grievous[G926] complaints[G157] against[G2596] Paul[G3972], which[G3739] they[G846] could[G2480] not[G3756] prove[G584].

verses.text: While he answered for himself, Neither against the law of the Jews, neither against the temple, nor yet against Caesar, have I offended any thing at all.
verses.strongsText: While[G2193] he[G846] answered[G626] for[G1063] himself[G846], Neither[G3754] [G3777] against[G1519] the[G3588] law[G3551] of[G1537] the[G3588] Jews[G2453], neither[G3777] against[G1519] the[G3588] temple[G2411], nor yet[G3777] against[G1519] Caesar[G2541], have[G2192] I[G1473] offended[G264] any thing[G4229] at all[G5100].

verses.text: But Festus, willing to do the Jews a pleasure, answered Paul, and said, Wilt thou go up to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these things before me?
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] Festus[G5347], willing[G2309] to[G1519] do[G2698] the[G3588] Jews[G2453] a pleasure[G5485], answered[G611] Paul[G3972], and[G2532] said[G2036], Wilt thou[G2309] go up[G305] to[G1519] Jerusalem[G2414], and[G2532] there[G1563] be[G1510] judged[G2919] of[G4012] these things[G5130] before[G1909] me[G1700]?

verses.text: Then said Paul, I stand at Caesar's judgment seat, where I ought to be judged: to the Jews have I done no wrong, as thou very well knowest.
verses.strongsText: Then[G1161] said[G2036] Paul[G3972], I[G1473] stand[G1510] [G2476] at[G1909] Caesar's[G2541] judgment seat[G968], where[G3757] I[G3165] ought[G1163] to[G1519] be[G1510] judged[G2919]: to[G1519] the[G3588] Jews[G2453] have[G2192] I[G1473] done[G91] no[G3762] wrong[G91], as[G5613] [G2532] thou[G4771] very well[G2566] knowest[G1921].

verses.text: For if I be an offender, or have committed any thing worthy of death, I refuse not to die: but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me, no man may deliver me unto them. I appeal unto Caesar.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] if[G1487] [G3303] I[G1473] be[G1510] an offender[G91], or[G2532] have[G2192] committed[G4238] any thing[G5100] worthy[G514] of[G1537] death[G2288], I[G1473] refuse[G3868] not[G3756] to[G1519] die[G599]: but[G1161] if[G1487] there[G1563] be[G2076] none[G3762] of[G1537] these things[G3739] whereof these[G3778] accuse[G2723] me[G3450], no man[G3762] may[G1410] deliver[G5483] me[G3165] unto[G1519] them[G846]. I[G1473] appeal unto[G1941] Caesar[G2541].

verses.text: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, Hast thou appealed unto Caesar? unto Caesar shalt thou go.
verses.strongsText: Then[G5119] Festus[G5347], when[G3753] he[G846] had[G2192] conferred[G4814] with[G3326] the[G3588] council[G4824], answered[G611], Hast thou[G4771] appealed unto[G1941] Caesar[G2541]? unto[G1909] Caesar[G2541] shalt[G4771] thou[G4771] go[G4198].

verses.text: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Caesarea to salute Festus.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] after[G1230] certain[G5100] days[G2250] king[G935] Agrippa[G67] and[G2532] Bernice[G959] came[G2658] unto[G1519] Caesarea[G2542] to[G1519] salute[G782] Festus[G5347].

verses.text: And when they had been there many days, Festus declared Paul's cause unto the king, saying, There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix:
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] when[G5613] they[G846] had[G2192] been[G1304] there[G1563] many[G4119] days[G2250], Festus[G5347] declared[G394] Paul's[G3972] cause[G2596] unto[G1519] the[G3588] king[G935], saying[G3004], There[G1563] is[G2076] a certain[G5100] man[G435] left[G2641] in[G1722] bonds[G1198] by[G5259] Felix[G5344]:

verses.text: About whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed *me*, desiring *to have* judgment against him.
verses.strongsText: About[G4012] whom[G3739], when[G1096] I[G3450] was[G1096] at[G1519] Jerusalem[G2414], the[G3588] chief priests[G749] and[G2532] the[G3588] elders[G4245] of[G1537] the[G3588] Jews[G2453] informed[G1718] me[G1691], desiring[G154] to[G1519] have[G2192] judgment[G1349] against[G2596] him[G846].

verses.text: To whom I answered, It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die, before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face, and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him.
verses.strongsText: To[G4314] whom[G3739] I[G1473] answered[G611],[G3754] It[G846] is[G2076] not[G3756] the[G3588] manner[G1485] of[G1537] the[G3588] Romans[G4514] to[G1519] deliver[G5483] any[G5100] man[G444] to[G1519] die[G684], before[G4250] that[G2228] he[G846] which[G3739] is[G2076] accused[G2723] have[G2192] the[G3588] accusers[G2725] face to[G1519] face[G2596] [G4383],[G5037] and[G2532] have[G2983] licence[G5117] to[G1519] answer for[G1063] himself[G627] concerning[G4012] the[G3588] crime laid against him[G1462].

verses.text: Therefore, when they were come hither, without any delay on the morrow I sat on the judgment seat, and commanded the man to be brought forth.
verses.strongsText: Therefore[G3767], when[G3753] they[G846] were[G2258] come[G4905] hither[G1759], without[G4160] any[G3367] delay[G311] on the[G3588] morrow[G1836] I[G1473] sat[G2523] on[G1909] the[G3588] judgment seat[G968], and[G2532] commanded[G2753] the[G3588] man[G435] to[G1519] be[G1510] brought forth[G71].

verses.text: Against whom when the accusers stood up, they brought none accusation of such things as I supposed:
verses.strongsText: Against[G4012] whom[G3739] when[G3753] the[G3588] accusers[G2725] stood up[G2476], they[G846] brought[G2018] none[G3762] accusation[G156] of[G1537] such things as[G3739] I[G1473] supposed[G5282]:

verses.text: But had certain questions against him of their own superstition, and of one Jesus, which was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] had[G2192] certain[G5100] questions[G2213] against[G4314] him[G846] of[G4012] their[G846] own[G2398] superstition[G1175], and[G2532] of[G4012] one[G5100] Jesus[G2424], which[G3739] was[G2258] dead[G2348], whom[G3739] Paul[G3972] affirmed[G5335] to[G1519] be[G1510] alive[G2198].

verses.text: And because I doubted of such manner of questions, I asked *him* whether he would go to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these matters.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] because I[G1473] doubted[G639] of[G1519] such[G5127] manner[G4012] of[G1537] questions[G2214], I[G1473] asked[G3004] him[G846] whether[G1487] he[G846] would[G1014] go[G4198] to[G1519] Jerusalem[G2419], and[G2532] there[G2546] be[G1510] judged[G2919] of[G4012] these matters[G5130].

verses.text: But when Paul had appealed to be reserved unto the hearing of Augustus, I commanded him to be kept till I might send him to Caesar.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] when[G3753] Paul[G3972] had[G2192] appealed[G1941] to[G1519] be[G1510] reserved[G5083] [G846] unto[G1519] the[G3588] hearing[G1233] of[G1537] Augustus[G4575], I[G1473] commanded[G2753] him[G846] to[G1519] be[G1510] kept[G5083] till[G2193] [G3739] I[G1473] might send[G3992] him[G846] to[G4314] Caesar[G2541].

verses.text: Then Agrippa said unto Festus, I would also hear the man myself. To morrow, said he, thou shalt hear him.
verses.strongsText: Then[G1161] Agrippa[G67] said[G5346] unto[G4314] Festus[G5347], I[G1473] would[G1014] also[G2532] hear[G191] the[G3588] man[G444] myself[G846]. To[G1519] morrow[G839],[G1161] said[G5346] he[G846], thou[G4771] shalt[G4771] hear[G191] him[G846].

verses.text: And on the morrow, when Agrippa was come, and Bernice, with great pomp, and was entered into the place of hearing, with the chief captains, and principal men of the city, at Festus' commandment Paul was brought forth.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] on the[G3588] morrow[G1887], when[G3767] Agrippa[G67] was[G2258] come[G2064], and[G2532] Bernice[G959], with[G3326] great[G4183] pomp[G5325], and[G2532] was[G2258] entered[G1525] into[G1519] the[G3588] place of[G1537] hearing[G201], with[G4862] [G5037] the[G3588] chief captains[G5506], and[G2532] principal[G2596] [G1851] men[G435] of[G5607] the[G3588] city[G4172], at[G2532] Festus'[G5347] commandment[G2753] Paul[G3972] was[G2258] brought forth[G71].

verses.text: And Festus said, King Agrippa, and all men which are here present with us, ye see this man, about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me, both at Jerusalem, and *also* here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] Festus[G5347] said[G5346], King[G935] Agrippa[G67], and[G2532] all[G3956] men[G435] which[G3588] are[G1526] here present[G4840] with[G3326] us[G2254], ye[G5210] see[G2334] this man[G5126], about[G4012] whom[G3739] all[G3956] the[G3588] multitude[G4128] of[G1537] the[G3588] Jews[G2453] have[G2192] dealt[G1793] with[G3326] me[G3427], both[G5037] at[G1722] Jerusalem[G2414], and[G2532] also here[G1759], crying[G1916] that[G3754] he[G846] ought[G1163] not[G3361] to[G1519] live[G2198] any longer[G3371].

verses.text: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and that he himself hath appealed to Augustus, I have determined to send him.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] when[G3753] I[G1473] found[G2638] that[G3754] he[G846] had[G2192] committed[G4238] nothing[G3367] worthy[G514] of[G1537] death[G2288], and[G2532] [G1161] that[G3754] he[G846] himself[G846] hath appealed[G5127] to[G1941] Augustus[G4575], I[G1473] have[G2192] determined[G2919] to[G1519] send[G3992] him[G846].

verses.text: Of whom I have no certain thing to write unto my lord. Wherefore I have brought him forth before you, and specially before thee, O king Agrippa, that, after examination had, I might have somewhat to write.
verses.strongsText: Of[G4012] whom[G3739] I[G1473] have[G2192] no[G3756] certain[G804] thing[G5100] to[G1519] write[G1125] unto[G1519] my[G3450] lord[G2962]. Wherefore[G1352] I[G1473] have[G2192] brought[G4254] him[G846] forth[G4254] before[G1909] you[G5216], and[G2532] specially[G3122] before[G1909] thee[G4675], O king[G935] Agrippa[G67], that[G3704], after[G3326] examination[G351] had[G1096], I[G1473] might have[G2192] somewhat[G5100] to[G1519] write[G1125].

verses.text: For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner, and not withal to signify the crimes *laid* against him.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] it[G846] seemeth[G1380] to[G1519] me[G3427] unreasonable[G249] to[G1519] send[G3992] a prisoner[G1198], and[G2532] not[G3756] withal[G3361] to[G1519] signify[G4591] the[G3588] crimes[G156] laid against[G2596] him[G846].

verses.text: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Thou art permitted to speak for thyself. Then Paul stretched forth the hand, and answered for himself:
verses.strongsText: Then[G1161] Agrippa[G67] said[G5346] unto[G4314] Paul[G3972], Thou[G4671] art permitted[G2010] to[G1519] speak[G3004] for[G5228] thyself[G4572]. Then[G5119] Paul[G3972] stretched forth[G1614] the[G3588] hand[G5495], and[G2532] answered for[G1063] himself[G626]:

verses.text: I think myself happy, king Agrippa, because I shall answer for myself this day before thee touching all the things whereof I am accused of the Jews:
verses.strongsText: I[G1473] think[G2233] myself[G1683] happy[G3107], king[G935] Agrippa[G67], because I[G1473] shall[G3195] answer for[G1063] myself[G626] this day[G4594] before[G1909] thee[G4675] touching[G4012] all[G3956] the[G3588] things[G3956] whereof[G3739] I[G1473] am[G1510] accused[G1458] of[G5259] the[G3588] Jews[G2453]:

verses.text: Especially *because I know* thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews: wherefore I beseech thee to hear me patiently.
verses.strongsText: Especially[G3122] because I[G1473] know[G1492] thee[G4571] to[G1519] be[G5607] expert[G1109] [G5037] in[G1722] all[G3956] customs[G1485] and[G2532] questions[G2213] which[G3739] are[G1526] among[G2596] the[G3588] Jews[G2453]: wherefore[G1352] I[G1473] beseech[G1189] thee[G4675] to[G1519] hear[G191] me[G3450] patiently[G3116].

verses.text: My manner of life from my youth, which was at the first among mine own nation at Jerusalem, know all the Jews;
verses.strongsText: My[G3450] manner[G3303] [G3767] of[G1537] life[G981] from[G1537] my[G3450] youth[G3503], which[G3588] was[G1096] at[G575] the[G3588] first[G746] among[G1722] mine[G3450] own nation[G1484] at[G1722] Jerusalem[G2414], know[G2467] all[G3956] the[G3588] Jews[G2453];

verses.text: Which knew me from the beginning, if they would testify, that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.
verses.strongsText: Which[G3739] knew[G4267] me[G3165] from[G575] the[G3588] beginning[G509], if[G1437] they[G846] would[G2309] testify[G3140], that[G3754] after[G2596] the[G3588] most straitest[G196] sect[G139] of[G1537] our[G2251] religion[G2356] I[G1473] lived[G2198] a Pharisee[G5330].

verses.text: And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God unto our fathers:
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] now[G3568] I[G1473] stand[G2476] and[G2532] am[G1510] judged[G2919] for[G1909] the[G3588] hope[G1680] of[G1537] the[G3588] promise[G1860] made[G1096] of[G5259] God[G2316] unto[G4314] our[G2257] fathers[G3962]:

verses.text: Unto which *promise* our twelve tribes, instantly serving *God* day and night, hope to come. For which hope's sake, king Agrippa, I am accused of the Jews.
verses.strongsText: Unto[G1519] which[G3739] promise our[G2257] twelve tribes[G1429], instantly[G1722] [G1616] serving[G3000] God day[G2250] and[G2532] night[G3571], hope[G1679] to[G1519] come[G2658]. For[G4012] which[G3739] hope's sake[G1680], king[G935] Agrippa[G67], I[G1473] am[G1510] accused[G1458] of[G5259] the[G3588] Jews[G2453].

verses.text: Why should it be thought a thing incredible with you, that God should raise the dead?
verses.strongsText: Why[G5101] should it[G846] be[G1510] thought a thing[G2919] incredible[G571] with[G3844] you[G5213], that[G1487] God[G2316] should raise[G1453] the[G3588] dead[G3498]?

verses.text: I verily thought with myself, that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.strongsText: I[G1473] verily[G3303] [G3767] thought[G1380] with[G3326] myself[G1683], that[G3754] I[G1473] ought[G1163] to[G1519] do[G4238] many things[G4183] contrary[G1727] to[G4314] the[G3588] name[G3686] of[G1537] Jesus[G2424] of[G1537] Nazareth[G3480].

verses.text: Which thing I also did in Jerusalem: and many of the saints did I shut up in prison, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death, I gave my voice against *them*.
verses.strongsText: Which[G3739] thing[G3739] I[G4160] also[G2532] did[G4160] in[G1722] Jerusalem[G2414]: and[G2532] many[G4183] of[G1537] the[G3588] saints[G40] did[G2623] I[G1473] shut up[G2623] in[G1722] prison[G5438], having received[G2983] authority[G1849] from[G3844] the[G3588] chief priests[G749]; and[G5037] when[G3753] they[G846] were[G2258] put to[G1519] death[G337], I[G1473] gave[G2702] my[G3450] voice[G5586] against them[G846].

verses.text: And I punished them oft in every synagogue, and compelled *them* to blaspheme; and being exceedingly mad against them, I persecuted *them* even unto strange cities.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] I[G1473] punished[G5097] them[G846] oft[G4178] in[G2596] every[G3956] synagogue[G4864], and[G2532] compelled[G315] them[G846] to[G1519] blaspheme[G987]; and[G5037] being[G1693] exceedingly[G4057] mad against[G1693] them[G846], I[G1473] persecuted[G1377] them[G846] even[G2532] unto[G1519] [G2193] strange[G1854] cities[G4172].

verses.text: Whereupon as I went to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests,
verses.strongsText: [G2532] Whereupon[G1722] [G3739] as[G5613] I[G1473] went[G4198] to[G1519] Damascus[G1154] with[G3326] authority[G1849] and[G2532] commission[G2011] from[G3844] the[G3588] chief priests[G749],

verses.text: At midday, O king, I saw in the way a light from heaven, above the brightness of the sun, shining round about me and them which journeyed with me.
verses.strongsText: At midday[G2250] [G3319], O king[G935], I[G1473] saw[G1492] in[G2596] the[G3588] way[G3598] a light[G5457] from[G575] heaven[G3771], above[G5228] the[G3588] brightness[G2987] of[G1537] the[G3588] sun[G2246], shining round about[G4034] me[G3165] and[G2532] them[G846] which[G3739] journeyed[G4198] with[G4862] me[G1698].

verses.text: And when we were all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice speaking unto me, and saying in the Hebrew tongue, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? *it is* hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] when[G3753] we[G2257] were[G2667] all[G3956] fallen[G2667] to[G1519] the[G3588] earth[G1093], I[G1473] heard[G191] a voice[G5456] speaking[G2980] unto[G4314] me[G3165], and[G2532] saying[G3004] in[G1722] the[G3588] Hebrew[G1446] tongue[G1258], Saul[G4549], Saul[G4549], why[G5101] persecutest thou[G1377] me[G3165]? it[G846] is[G2076] hard[G4642] for[G1063] thee[G4671] to[G1519] kick[G2979] against[G4314] the[G3588] pricks[G2759].

verses.text: And I said, Who art thou, Lord? And he said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] I[G1473] said[G2036], Who[G5101] art thou[G1488], Lord[G2962]? And[G1161] he[G846] said[G2036], I[G1473] am[G1510] Jesus[G2424] whom[G3739] thou[G4771] persecutest[G1377].

verses.text: But rise, and stand upon thy feet: for I have appeared unto thee for this purpose, to make thee a minister and a witness both of these things which thou hast seen, and of those things in the which I will appear unto thee;
verses.strongsText: But[G235] rise[G450], and[G2532] stand[G2476] upon[G1909] thy[G4675] feet[G4228]: for[G1063] I[G1473] have[G2192] appeared[G3700] unto[G1519] thee[G4671] for[G1519] this purpose[G5124], to[G1519] make[G4400] thee[G4571] a minister[G5257] and[G2532] a witness[G3144] both[G5037] of[G1537] these things which[G3739] thou[G4771] hast seen[G1492], and[G5037] of[G1537] those things in[G1722] the[G3588] which[G3739] I[G1473] will appear[G3700] unto[G1519] thee[G4671];

verses.text: Delivering thee from the people, and *from* the Gentiles, unto whom now I send thee,
verses.strongsText: Delivering[G1807] thee[G4571] from[G1537] the[G3588] people[G2992], and[G2532] from[G575] the[G3588] Gentiles[G1484], unto[G1519] whom[G3739] now[G3568] I[G1473] send[G649] thee[G4571],

verses.text: To open their eyes, *and* to turn *them* from darkness to light, and *from* the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.
verses.strongsText: To[G1519] open[G455] their[G846] eyes[G3788], and[G2532] to[G1519] turn[G1994] them[G846] from[G575] darkness[G4655] to[G1519] light[G5457], and[G2532] from[G575] the[G3588] power[G1849] of[G1537] Satan[G4567] unto[G1909] God[G2316], that[G3754] they[G846] may receive[G2983] forgiveness[G859] of[G1537] sins[G266], and[G2532] inheritance[G2819] among[G1722] them[G846] which[G3739] are[G1526] sanctified[G37] by[G1223] faith[G4102] that[G3754] is[G2076] in[G1519] me[G1691].

verses.text: Whereupon, O king Agrippa, I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision:
verses.strongsText: Whereupon[G3606], O king[G935] Agrippa[G67], I[G1473] was[G1096] not[G3756] disobedient[G545] unto[G1519] the[G3588] heavenly[G3770] vision[G3701]:

verses.text: But shewed first unto them of Damascus, and at Jerusalem, and throughout all the coasts of Judaea, and *then* to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, and do works meet for repentance.
verses.strongsText: But[G235] shewed[G518] [G518] first[G4412] unto[G1519] them[G846] of[G1722] Damascus[G1154], and[G2532] at Jerusalem[G2414], and[G5037] throughout[G1519] all[G3956] the[G3588] coasts[G5561] of[G1537] Judaea[G2449], and[G2532] then[G5119] to[G1519] the[G3588] Gentiles[G1484], that[G3754] they[G846] should repent[G3340] and[G2532] turn[G1994] to[G1909] God[G2316], and[G2532] do[G4238] works[G2041] meet[G514] for[G1063] repentance[G3341].

verses.text: For these causes the Jews caught me in the temple, and went about to kill *me*.
verses.strongsText: For[G1752] these causes[G5130] the[G3588] Jews[G2453] caught[G4815] me[G3165] in[G1722] the[G3588] temple[G2411], and[G2532] went about[G3987] to[G1519] kill[G1315] me[G1691].

verses.text: Having therefore obtained help of God, I continue unto this day, witnessing both to small and great, saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come:
verses.strongsText: Having[G5177] therefore[G3767] obtained[G5177] help[G1947] of[G3844] God[G2316], I[G1473] continue[G2476] unto[G891] this[G5026] day[G2250], witnessing[G3140] both[G5037] to[G1519] small[G3398] and[G2532] great[G3173], saying[G3004] none other things[G3762] than[G1622] those which[G3739] [G5037] the[G3588] prophets[G4396] and[G2532] Moses[G3475] did say[G2980] should[G3195] come[G1096]:

verses.text: That Christ should suffer, *and* that he should be the first that should rise from the dead, and should shew light unto the people, and to the Gentiles.
verses.strongsText: That[G1487] Christ[G5547] should suffer[G3805], and[G2532] that[G1487] he[G846] should be[G1510] the[G3588] first[G4413] that[G3754] should rise[G386] from[G1537] the[G3588] dead[G3498], and[G2532] should[G3195] shew[G2605] light[G5457] unto[G1519] the[G3588] people[G2992], and[G2532] to[G1519] the[G3588] Gentiles[G1484].

verses.text: And as he thus spake for himself, Festus said with a loud voice, Paul, thou art beside thyself; much learning doth make thee mad.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] as[G5613] he[G846] thus[G5023] spake for[G1063] himself[G626], Festus[G5347] said[G5346] with[G3326] a loud[G3173] voice[G5456], Paul[G3972], thou[G4771] art beside thyself[G3105]; much[G4183] learning[G1121] doth make[G4062] thee[G4571] mad[G1519] [G3130].

verses.text: But he said, I am not mad, most noble Festus; but speak forth the words of truth and soberness.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] he[G846] said[G5346], I[G1473] am[G3105] not[G3756] mad[G3105], most noble[G2903] Festus[G5347]; but[G235] speak forth[G669] the[G3588] words[G4487] of[G1537] truth[G225] and[G2532] soberness[G4997].

verses.text: For the king knoweth of these things, before whom also I speak freely: for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him; for this thing was not done in a corner.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] the[G3588] king[G935] knoweth[G1987] of[G4012] these[G5130] things, before[G4314] whom[G3739] also[G2532] I[G1473] speak[G2980] freely[G3955]: for[G1063] I[G1473] am[G1510] persuaded[G3982] that[G3756] none[G5100] [G3762] of[G1537] these things[G5130] are[G1526] hidden[G2990] from[G575] him[G846]; for[G1063] this thing[G5124] was[G2076] not[G3756] done[G4238] in[G1722] a corner[G1137].

verses.text: King Agrippa, believest thou the prophets? I know that thou believest.
verses.strongsText: King[G935] Agrippa[G67], believest thou[G4100] the[G3588] prophets[G4396]? I[G1473] know[G1492] that[G3754] thou[G4771] believest[G4100].

verses.text: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.
verses.strongsText: Then[G1161] Agrippa[G67] said[G5346] unto[G4314] Paul[G3972], Almost[G1722] [G3641] thou[G4771] persuadest[G3982] me[G3165] to[G1519] be[G1096] a Christian[G5546].

verses.text: And Paul said, I would to God, that not only thou, but also all that hear me this day, were both almost, and altogether such as I am, except these bonds.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] Paul[G3972] said[G2036], I[G1473] would[G302] [G2172] to[G1519] God[G2316], that[G3754] not[G3756] only[G3440] thou[G4571], but[G235] also[G2532] all[G3956] that[G3754] hear[G191] me[G3450] this day[G4594], were[G1096] both[G2532] almost[G1722] [G3641], and[G2532] altogether[G1722] [G4183] such[G5108] as[G3697] [G2504] I[G1473] am[G1510], except[G3924] these[G5130] bonds[G1199].

verses.text: And when he had thus spoken, the king rose up, and the governor, and Bernice, and they that sat with them:
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] when[G3753] he[G846] had[G2036] thus[G5023] spoken[G2036], the[G3588] king[G935] rose up[G450], and[G2532] the[G3588] governor[G2232], and[G5037] Bernice[G959], and[G2532] they[G846] that[G3754] sat with[G4775] them[G846]:

verses.text: And when they were gone aside, they talked between themselves, saying, This man doeth nothing worthy of death or of bonds.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] when[G3753] they[G846] were[G2258] gone aside[G402], they[G846] talked[G2980] between[G4314] themselves[G240], saying[G3004],[G3754] This[G3778] man[G444] doeth[G4238] nothing[G3762] worthy[G514] of[G1537] death[G2288] or[G2228] of[G1537] bonds[G1199].

verses.text: Then said Agrippa unto Festus, This man might have been set at liberty, if he had not appealed unto Caesar.
verses.strongsText: Then[G1161] said[G5346] Agrippa[G67] unto[G1519] Festus[G5347], This[G3778] man[G444] might[G1410] have[G2192] been[G1096] set at liberty[G630], if[G1508] he[G846] had[G1941] not[G1508] appealed unto[G1941] Caesar[G2541].

verses.text: And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto *one* named Julius, a centurion of Augustus' band.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] when[G5613] it[G846] was[G2258] determined[G2919] that[G3754] we[G2248] should sail[G636] into[G1519] Italy[G2482], they[G846] delivered[G3860] [G5037] Paul[G3972] and[G2532] certain[G5100] other[G2087] prisoners[G1202] unto[G1519] one named[G3686] Julius[G2457], a centurion[G1543] of[G1537] Augustus'[G4575] band[G4686].

verses.text: And entering into a ship of Adramyttium, we launched, meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia; *one* Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] entering[G1910] into[G1519] a ship[G4143] of[G1537] Adramyttium[G98], we[G2249] launched[G321], meaning[G3195] to[G1519] sail[G4126] by[G2596] the[G3588] coasts[G5117] of[G1537] Asia[G773]; one Aristarchus[G708], a Macedonian[G3110] of[G1537] Thessalonica[G2331], being[G5607] with[G4862] us[G2254].

verses.text: And the next *day* we touched at Sidon. And Julius courteously entreated Paul, and gave *him* liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself.
verses.strongsText: And[G5037] the[G3588] next[G2087] day we[G2249] touched[G2609] at[G1519] Sidon[G4605]. And[G5037] Julius[G2457] courteously[G5364] entreated[G5530] Paul[G3972], and[G2532] gave him[G846] liberty[G2010] to[G1519] go[G4198] unto[G4314] his[G846] friends[G5384] to[G1519] refresh himself[G5177] [G1958].

verses.text: And when we had launched from thence, we sailed under Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.

verses.text: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? *Is* God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)

(I[G1473] speak[G3004] as[G2596] a man[G444])

verses.text: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?
verses.strongsText: God forbid[G3361] [G1096]: for[G1063] then[G1893] how[G4459] shall[G2919] God[G2316] judge[G2919] the[G3588] world[G2889]?

verses.text: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] if[G1487] the[G3588] truth[G225] of[G1537] God[G2316] hath more abounded[G4052] through[G1722] my[G1699] lie[G5582] unto[G1519] his[G846] glory[G1391]; why[G5101] yet[G2089] am[G2919] I[G1473] also[G2504] judged[G2919] as[G5613] a sinner[G268]?

verses.text: And not *rather*, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] not[G3361] rather, (as[G2531] we[G2249] be[G1510] slanderously reported[G987], and[G2532] as[G2531] some[G5100] affirm[G5346] that[G3754] we[G2248] say[G3004],)[G3754] Let us[G2248] do[G4160] evil[G2556], that[G2443] good[G18] may come[G2064]? whose[G3739] damnation[G2917] is[G2076] just[G1738].

verses.text: What then? are we better *than they*? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
verses.strongsText: What[G5101] then[G3767]? are[G1526] we[G2249] better[G4284] than they[G846]? No[G3756], in[G1722] no wise[G3843]: for[G1063] we[G2249] have[G2192] before[G4253] proved[G4256] both[G5037] Jews[G2453] and[G2532] Gentiles[G1672], that[G3754] they[G846] are[G1511] all[G3956] under[G5259] sin[G266];

verses.text: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:
verses.strongsText: As[G2531] it[G846] is[G2076] written[G1125],[G3754] There[G1563] is[G2076] none[G3756] righteous[G1342], no, not[G3761] one[G1520]:

verses.strongsText: There[G1563] is[G2076] none[G3756] that[G3754] understandeth[G4920], there[G1563] is[G2076] none[G3756] that[G3754] seeketh after[G1567] God[G2316].

verses.text: Their throat *is* an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps *is* under their lips:

verses.strongsText: Whose[G3739] mouth[G4750] is[G2076] full[G1073] of[G1537] cursing[G685] and[G2532] bitterness[G4088]:

verses.strongsText: Their[G846] feet[G4228] are[G1526] swift[G3691] to[G1519] shed[G1632] blood[G129]:

verses.strongsText: Destruction[G4938] and[G2532] misery[G5004] are[G1526] in[G1722] their[G846] ways[G3598]:

verses.strongsText: And[G2532] the[G3588] way[G3598] of[G1537] peace[G1515] have[G1097] they[G846] not[G3756] known[G1097]:

verses.text: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.

verses.text: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law *is* the knowledge of sin.
verses.strongsText: Therefore[G1360] by[G1537] the[G3588] deeds[G2041] of[G1537] the[G3588] law[G3551] there[G1563] shall[G1344] no[G3956] [G3756] flesh[G4561] be[G1510] justified[G1344] in[G1722] his[G846] sight[G1799]: for[G1063] by[G1223] the[G3588] law[G3551] is[G2076] the[G3588] knowledge[G1922] of[G1537] sin[G266].

verses.text: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] now[G3570] the[G3588] righteousness[G1343] of[G1537] God[G2316] without[G5565] the[G3588] law[G3551] is[G2076] manifested[G5319], being witnessed[G3140] by[G5259] the[G3588] law[G3551] and[G2532] the[G3588] prophets[G4396];

verses.text: Even the righteousness of God *which is* by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:

verses.text: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:

verses.text: To declare, *I say*, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.

verses.text: Where *is* boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.

verses.text: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
verses.strongsText: Therefore[G3767] we[G2249] conclude[G3049] that[G3754] a man[G444] is[G2076] justified[G1344] by[G1223] faith[G4102] without[G5565] the[G3588] deeds[G2041] of[G1537] the[G3588] law[G3551].

verses.text: *Is he* the God of the Jews only? *is he* not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:
Seeing *it is* one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.

verses.text: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,
verses.strongsText: Even as[G2509] David[G1138] also[G2532] describeth[G3004] the[G3588] blessedness[G3108] of[G1537] the[G3588] man[G444], unto[G1519] whom[G3739] God[G2316] imputeth[G3049] righteousness[G1343] without[G5565] works[G2041],

verses.text: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which *he had yet* being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:

verses.text: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, *was* not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

verses.text: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, *even* God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.

verses.strongsText: For[G1063] the[G3588] woman[G1135] which[G3739] hath an husband[G5220] is[G2076] bound[G1210] by[G1223] the[G3588] law[G3551] to[G1519] her husband[G435] so[G3779] long as[G5613] he[G846] liveth[G2198]; but[G1161] if[G1437] the[G3588] husband[G435] be[G1510] dead[G599], she[G846] is[G2076] loosed[G2673] from[G575] the[G3588] law[G3551] of[G1537] her husband[G435].

verses.strongsText: So[G3779] then[G686] [G3767] if[G1437], while[G2193] her husband[G435] liveth[G2198], she[G846] be[G1510] married[G1096] to[G1519] another[G2087] man[G435], she[G846] shall[G1510] be[G1510] called[G5537] an adulteress[G3428]: but[G1161] if[G1437] her husband[G435] be[G1510] dead[G599], she[G846] is[G2076] free[G1658] from[G575] that[G3754] law[G3551]; so[G3779] that[G3754] she[G846] is[G1511] no[G3361] adulteress[G3428], though she[G846] be[G1510] married[G1096] to[G1519] another[G2087] man[G435].

verses.text: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, *even* to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.

verses.text: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.

verses.text: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not *in* the oldness of the letter.

verses.text: What shall we say then? *Is* the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.
verses.strongsText: What[G5101] shall[G1510] we[G2249] say[G2046] then[G3767]? Is[G2076] the[G3588] law[G3551] sin[G266]? God forbid[G3361] [G1096]. verses.text: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin *was* dead.

verses.text: And not only *they*, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, *to wit*, the redemption of our body.

verses.text: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?

verses.text: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

verses.text: What shall we then say to these things? If God *be* for us, who *can be* against us?

verses.text: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent.

verses.text: For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, *are called*:

verses.text: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed *to be somewhat* in conference added nothing to me:

verses.text: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before *them* all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?

verses.text: We *who are* Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,

God forbid[G3361] [G1096].

verses.text: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.
